method.grouping: Supplied source_name, source SHA256; original family links retained
method.panel_similarity: All 837 training and 64 existing v4 validation annotation panels fingerprinted; exact RGB+size, dHash<=6 AND pHash<=10; different-family pairs only
method.similarity_result: No candidate pairs at these thresholds; this is not evidence of scene independence
method.visual_review: All 245 named training families inventoried on 11 sheets, comparing first annotated panel per variant where available. All 1,917 text crops individually inspected on 40 sheets. All 315 initially-full non-number crops and 78 targeted crops reinspected on 12 additional sheets; same AI reviewer, not independent second review.
